rationale: Canonical SMILES is a structure-level identifier. ChEMBL molecule, PubChem compound, and composite molecule use compatible structure normalization; ChEMBL activity keeps the value as inherited molecule context rather than molecule ownership.
Internal config, DQ, join and contract surfaces use assay_id. Provider-native input filters retain assay_chembl_id as the external column name.
Internal schema, merge and DQ surfaces use molecule_id. Provider-native ChEMBL filters still accept molecule_chembl_id at the ingestion boundary.

doi is already the canonical identifier name across provider, composite and Gold surfaces.
InChIKey is a structure-level identifier shared by ChEMBL molecule, PubChem compound, and composite molecule join paths with canonical uppercase normalization.
PubChem h_bond_acceptor_count and legacy hba map to the canonical hba_count descriptor.
PubChem h_bond_donor_count maps to the canonical hbd_count descriptor.
InChIKey is the primary molecule composite join key and is canonical across ChEMBL/PubChem surfaces.
PubChem xlogp maps to canonical logp while source-specific method semantics remain documented in molecule contracts.
molecular_weight is canonical across ChEMBL/PubChem molecule descriptor surfaces.
PubChem tpsa maps to the canonical polar_surface_area descriptor.
PubChem inchi maps to standard_inchi for composite molecule merge and Gold-facing contracts.
Field-name identity/alias rule for business identifiers and publication anchors.
Provider affiliations fields normalize to affiliation_list.
PubMed structured_affiliations normalize to affiliation_structured.
Provider reference_count fields normalize to citations_made.
Provider citation_count fields normalize to citations_received.
PubMed journal_title is normalized to the canonical journal field.
Provider-specific abbreviated journal fields normalize to journal_name_short.
Provider first_page fields normalize to page_first.
Provider last_page fields normalize to page_last.
Provider pages fields normalize to page_range.
Provider document/source type fields are normalized to publication_type before composite merge and Gold validation.
Provider year fields are normalized to publication_year. Nullable integer to Gold number compatibility remains explicitly governed by contract tests.
SemanticScholar fields_of_study normalize to subject_fields and remain distinct from MeSH/topic clusters.
Provider keyword/subject arrays normalize to subject_keywords when they represent generic publication keywords.
PubMed mesh_terms normalize to subject_mesh and remain distinct from generic subject_keywords.
OpenAlex topics normalize to subject_topics.
All normalized publication configs and composite join paths use title. Historical provider-prefixed title aliases are retained only as migration references in registry/docs.
PubMed provider input still arrives as pubmed_id, but normalized schema, join keys and DQ contracts use pmid.
